title: A customer's recent orders
sql:
SELECT
  id,
  customer_id,
  total,
  created_at
FROM orders
WHERE
  customer_id = 42
ORDER BY
  created_at DESC,
  id DESC
LIMIT 50

title: Find the rare refunds
sql:
SELECT
  id,
  total
FROM orders
WHERE
  status = 'refunded'
ORDER BY
  id
LIMIT 100

title: Most orders are completed
sql:
SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(total) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE
  status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
  status

title: Highest value purchases
sql:
SELECT
  id,
  total
FROM orders
ORDER BY
  total DESC NULLS LAST,
  id DESC
LIMIT 50

title: Orders from Paris
sql:
SELECT
  o.id,
  c.name,
  o.total
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE
  c.city = 'Paris'
ORDER BY
  o.id
LIMIT 100

title: A customer's line items
sql:
SELECT
  o.id,
  i.id AS item_id,
  i.quantity
FROM orders AS o
JOIN items AS i
  ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE
  o.customer_id = 42
ORDER BY
  o.id,
  i.id
LIMIT 100

title: Revenue by customer
sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(total) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE
  customer_id < 20
GROUP BY
  customer_id
ORDER BY
  customer_id

title: Deep pagination
sql:
SELECT
  id,
  created_at
FROM orders
ORDER BY
  created_at DESC,
  id DESC
LIMIT 50
OFFSET 50000

title: Recent orders, through a CTE
sql:
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    total
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    customer_id = 42
)
SELECT
  id,
  total
FROM recent
ORDER BY
  id
LIMIT 50

title: An indexed primary key lookup
sql:
SELECT
  id,
  total
FROM orders
WHERE
  id = 42

title: NULLs and an anti-join
sql:
SELECT
  id
FROM customers
WHERE
  NOT id IN (
    SELECT
      customer_id
    FROM orders
  )
ORDER BY
  id
LIMIT 100

title: Keep every repeated purchase
sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  total
FROM orders
WHERE
  customer_id = 42

title: A write hidden inside a CTE
sql:
WITH removed AS (
  DELETE FROM orders
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  id
FROM removed

title: Random ordering cannot be verified
sql:
SELECT
  id
FROM orders
ORDER BY
  RANDOM()
LIMIT 10

title: Pagination needs a tie-breaker
sql:
SELECT
  id
FROM orders
ORDER BY
  status
LIMIT 50
